name: Wild Goose Storage Lateral

values.StartLocation: Wild Goose Storage field, Butte County

researcher_notes: No existing row for Wild Goose, Delevan or Line 400 in the 2026-10-02 gas snapshot. The only source found that states the figures is the EIA August 2026 natural gas pipeline projects workbook, historical projects sheet, Excel row 309: Wild Goose Lateral, operator Wild Goose Storage Inc, completed 20 November 2003, 25 miles, 30 inch, 700 MMcf/d added capacity, cost 20 million dollars, intrastate, California. 25 miles is about 40 km, above the 25 km threshold. The California PUC environmental report from March 2002 confirms a 30-inch connection pipeline to PG&E Lines 400 and 401 at the Delevan interconnect but does not state its length. One source only, so medium. Intrastate line, so FERC silence is expected. Owner has no legal form in the gazetteer and is recorded as EIA spells it. The county names and exact route were not found. Second source (state regulator or operator) not found; the search tool hit its session limit. Route not found; no route.
